messages:
Elena: Quick thread — PulseWorks case story & webinar. Need: interview permissions, quote approvals, consent on reg form, and SFDC webhook routing to AE queue. Brief: https://redwood.docs/pulseworks-brief
Ravi: I'll own interview scheduling. Who are the spokes? CTO + Head of ML? Also want a 4-min demo mid-webinar.
Elena: Yes to both. Demo right after CTO panel. Embargo target June 9. Legal signoff by June 2.
Tom: Draft pull quote: "PulseWorks saw meaningful inference cost savings after migrating to Redwood". Can we be more precise?
Kacie: Legal note — avoid percent claims unless PulseWorks provides explicit numbers in email. Tag any percent with [LEGAL]. If they ask for transcript redaction/NDA, add 3 days.
Ravi: Sending quote to PulseWorks for redline now. Also asking for permission to record and to include a 30s promo clip.
Elena: Registration needs consent checkbox: "I consent to being contacted by Redwood and to the recording of this webinar for marketing purposes." Also add hidden field consent=true for webhook.
salesops-bot: webhook test passed in staging -> SFDC campaign Pulse-Q2-Web. Will map lead.owner to queue: ae-pulse when source=webinar.
Kacie: Confirmed. I'll review the final quote lines once PulseWorks returns redlines. If they push for NDA, let me know immediately.
Tom: PulseWorks replied: approved quote but redacted one sentence about latency numbers. They OK the 42% stat if we include their signed email.
Elena: Great — keep percent out unless we have the email. Ravi, lock interview times and send calendar invites with recording consent. Draft embargo note in the brief.
Ravi: Doodle out, invites queued. Will flag calendar events as "Recording—marketing use".
Elena: TL;DR: interviews scheduling, legal looped, reg consent added, SFDC webhook routing to ae-pulse, embargo June 9. Check-in tomorrow AM. :thumbsup:
